purpose: Issue #65 Stage A: attribute CPU time on the accepted-submit (every-commit and group-commit), query and crumb-advisory paths on the GB10 Spark, unpinned and pinned to each core class. Seconds per operation and CPU microseconds (getrusage) are the measured units; PMU counts are supporting units if the host permits them. Decides whether CPU control flow (branch mispredicts) is a measured wall-time driver before any hot-path change.
held_out: Nothing is tuned from this run. It only decides go or no-go for Stage B. A Stage B change, if any, needs its own matched before/after runs on identical inputs.
